summary: Customers can apply a discount code at checkout
description_md:
Marketing wants customers to be able to enter a promotion code in the cart. Codes are set up by the promo team in `bookshop.promotions`.

### Notes

- Discounts don't apply to gift cards.
- Shipping is calculated later, at payment, and is out of scope for this story.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a cart whose subtotal is at least the code's minimum spend, when a valid percentage code is applied, then the total is reduced by that percentage, rounded to the nearest cent.
Codes are case-insensitive and ignore surrounding spaces.
An expired code is rejected with the message "This code has expired" and the total is unchanged.
Only one code can be applied per cart; applying a second code replaces the first.
If the subtotal is below the code's minimum spend, the code is rejected with "Spend $X more to use this code", where X is the shortfall.
The discount appears as a separate line on the order confirmation email.
